title: LTX 2.3 lipsync - wire the proven bench workflow into the app as a Flow
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 - The Flow track (merge of MPI-529 + MPI-552 + MPI-560, 2026-08-16). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md.

Third and last of the LTX 2.3 v2v Flow trio, after MPI-536 (foley) and MPI-520 (extend). Bench-proven and user-judged working: comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_v2v_lipdub_template.json, 35 nodes / 48 links, converting against 48188 to 33 API nodes with 0 unknown, 0 missing-required, 0 dangling. Already carries the injection contract from MPI-537 phase 4 - Input_Video, Input_Audio, Input_Positive, Input_Negative, Input_Seed, Output_Video - so no rename pass is owed. Ships as a FLOW, not a model op: no ModelDef, no supportedOps, no dep entries, /mpi-add-flow. It runs on the already-wired LTX 2.3 checkpoint.

BLOCKED on MPI-531, same as its two siblings: FlowStepField is select|button|toggle only, so authoring this Flow today means a new JS uiComponent that MPI-531 item 4 would then have to port.

WHAT THE FEATURE IS: the user supplies a VIDEO, a reference voice, and a line of dialogue; out comes new lip movement AND new audio in that voice. The supplied audio is a speaker-identity reference, never what the lips follow - frozen audio is PROVEN DEAD at guide 1.00/0.75/0.50, do not re-test it. Reference-audio mode IS the feature (voice consistency across clips, and making a silent character speak). Dub-by-transcription is OUT - it needs Whisper and a long-video loop.

FOUR CONSTRAINTS THIS FLOW MUST HANDLE, all learned the expensive way on MPI-537:
1. FACE SIZE IS A HARD INPUT REQUIREMENT and this card owns the decision - auto-crop to the face, warn, or refuse - when the user's clip is a wide shot. A 1920x1088 source squeezed to 960x544 left the head too small and nothing moved across three runs; the same graph on a head-and-shoulders crop worked. Nothing else about this feature matters more: it is the difference between working and appearing broken.
2. The face must be PRESENT and framed, not merely large - a first frame with the subject turned away gives the model no identity to hold and it invents one.
3. LINE LENGTH vs CLIP DURATION is the sync lever, judged: "I should leave now." syncs well on a 3.04s clip, "I don't know what is going on." does not. The UI has to relate the line to the duration, or offer a longer clip - the user cannot be left to guess.
4. Seed is a lottery on this model family; a still mouth on one seed is not a broken wiring.

UNTESTED: clips longer than 3s, multiple speakers (the LoRA is single-speaker), non-English dialogue, and whether a ~5s voice reference clones better than a 3s one.

Evidence: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-537/validation.md (every run with its prompt id) and docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md.

UNBLOCKED 2026-08-14: MPI-531 item 1 landed (FlowStepField slider/number/text) plus FlowDef.controls, so this Flow can be authored with NO uiComponent. Worked example to copy: docs/playbooks/add-flow/existing-flows/ltx-extend.md (MPI-520, shipped the same session).

REMAINING PREREQ, found while sequencing: this graph needs a weight that is NOT a dep yet - ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-lipdub-0.9.safetensors. It has to be staged to R2 and given a dependencies.js entry before the Flow can install for anyone. That cost is why MPI-520 (zero new weights) went first.
